plugins.name: atoi
plugins.description: Work in Atoi from the agent you are already in: Projects, Workspaces, the Workspace Thread, governed Tasks with change sets and proof, search, Inbox decisions, and receipts for every action.

tools.name: atoi_projects
tools.description: List, get, create, update, archive, or restore governed Atoi Projects. A list answers one Workspace: workspace_id, or your Personal Workspace when none is given.

tools.name: atoi_workspace
tools.description: Create or list your Atoi Workspaces, or show and bind the stable source associated with an Atoi Project.

tools.name: atoi_tasks
tools.description: List, get, start, cancel, continue, inspect, apply, or publish authoritative Atoi Task change sets. Poll get for wait semantics.

tools.name: atoi_threads
tools.description: Drive a workspace Thread the way the app does: resolve a workspace to its one Thread, list, inspect pending decisions, send, reply, steer, attach a file to the turn that carries it, retry, stop, react, approve or deny, launch a Task, pin, unpin, or read where the wait after each send went, through the authenticated operator surface.

tools.name: atoi_search
tools.description: Search accessible Atoi threads, messages, projects, Tasks, files, and outputs.

tools.name: atoi_inbox
tools.description: List Inbox cards and answer each in its own words: keep, edit, or dismiss a memory card; approve or deny an approval; snooze any card.

tools.name: atoi_ideas
tools.description: Read the Ideas the agent wrote for this account, refresh them, answer the current ask, or dismiss a connection suggestion.

tools.name: atoi_usage
tools.description: Read what this person's turns cost: today, the last days, and the models that spent it, from the model-decision receipts.

tools.name: atoi_plan
tools.description: List the plans in one Workspace or Project with their ids, titles, status and progress, or retire or restore one of the person's plans.

tools.name: atoi_automations
tools.description: List, inspect, create, update, toggle, trigger, or remove Atoi Automations with schedule and receipt readback.

tools.name: atoi_channels
tools.description: List and inspect user-owned Atoi Channels, open browser-native connection flows, revoke links, or send a receipt-backed test.

tools.name: atoi_skills
tools.description: List, inspect, enable, disable, or remove user-owned Atoi Skills with durable skill receipts.

tools.name: atoi_plugins
tools.description: List, inspect, install, enable, disable, or remove the pinned first-party Atoi plugin release with durable plugin receipts.

tools.name: atoi_settings
tools.description: Read canonical settings and connector state from the settings registry, set any writable non-secret setting by key, return one setting to the default it came from, or connect and disconnect browser-owned Atoi connections.

tools.name: atoi_doctor
tools.description: Return the canonical Atoi runtime readiness ledger and compact receipt without promoting unobserved checks to ready.
